plugin.description: Controls whatever is playing media on the computer - Spotify, a browser, a video player - and shows the running track with its cover art on the deck.
plugin.requirements: A player that speaks MPRIS, which most Linux media players do.

PlayPause.description: Starts playback if it is paused and pauses it if it is playing - the one key most setups want. It draws the cover art of the running track on the key by itself.

player_name.description: Control only this player. Left out it follows whichever player is currently active, which is what most setups want.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the track's cover art as the key's background.

show_label.description: Show the track title on the key below the icon.

Play.description: Starts playback. Use it together with Pause when play and pause should be separate keys; otherwise prefer PlayPause.

player_name.description: Control only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the track's cover art as the key's background.

show_label.description: Show the track title on the key below the icon.

Pause.description: Pauses playback. Pair it with Play on a neighbouring key.

player_name.description: Control only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the track's cover art as the key's background.

show_label.description: Show the track title on the key below the icon.

player_name.description: Control only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the track's cover art as the key's background.

show_label.description: Show the track title on the key below the icon.

Previous.description: Goes back to the previous track.

player_name.description: Control only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the track's cover art as the key's background.

show_label.description: Show the track title on the key below the icon.

Info.description: Shows what is playing: the title on top, the artist at the bottom and the cover art behind them. It only displays - put it next to PlayPause to build a small player.

player_name.description: Show only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

show_thumbnail.description: Draw the cover art as the key's background.

seperator_text.description: The line shown between title and artist.

idle_icon.description: Image to show while nothing is playing. Empty leaves the key blank.

Thumbnail.description: Draws the cover art onto the deck's background instead of onto one key. Put the same action on several keys to spread one large cover across them - each key shows its own piece.

player_name.description: Show only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

size_mode.description: How the cover is laid out: "fill" and "stretch" spread it over every key carrying this action, the grid sizes tile it over that many keys.

MediaDial.description: A media widget for the touch display of a Stream Deck Plus: it shows the running track with artist and cover, and the dial skips tracks.

player_name.description: Show only this player. Left out it follows the active player.

song_font_desc.description: Font for the track title, as a Pango description.

song_outline_size.description: Outline thickness behind the track title, so it stays readable on bright covers.

artist_font_desc.description: Font for the artist, as a Pango description.

artist_outline_size.description: Outline thickness behind the artist line.
